sections.heading: Description
sections.content: The Current Process Flow (L1–L4) visualizes existing processes across multiple levels of detail—from high-level business capabilities (L1) to granular workflows (L4). It offers a structured representation of current-state operations, roles, and system interactions. By aligning with the ACE model and 6D methodology, it ensures process understanding is consistent and standardized. This deliverable supports consultants in identifying bottlenecks, redundancies, and integration gaps that impact performance.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Provides a clear operational baseline for evaluating performance and identifying improvement opportunities. It enhances stakeholder alignment, accelerates diagnostics, and reduces project risk by ensuring everyone shares a common understanding of current operations.
